stock.description: WT Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding entity, offers a range of specialized and general construction services across Hong Kong. Its specialized operations encompass foundational construction, site preparation, demolition work, and ground investigation fieldwork. For general building, the company handles projects such as superstructure erection, slope upkeep, hoarding installation, renovation and extension activities, and various other construction tasks. Established in 2002, its principal office is located in Tai Kok Tsui, Hong Kong. The firm previously operated as a subsidiary of Talent Gain Ventures Limited.
